snippet.title: Here are 3 Simple Tricks to Fix your Claude Usage
snippet.description:
If your Claude Code keeps hitting usage limits, then here are three tricks to make it run way more efficiently.

First, always use /model OpusPlan.

It makes sure Claude uses Opus 4.6 for planning and Sonnet for everything else.

Why does this matter? Opus burns through tokens quite fast, and Sonnet is more than enough for actual coding.

So you save credits without losing quality.

Think of it like hiring an architect for the blueprints and a builder for the construction.

Two different skill sets, two different price tags.

Second, use /compact whenever your conversations are getting too long.

Claude re-reads your entire chat on every single message you send.

That gets expensive fast.

Run /compact and it compresses everything into a tight summary, so you can keep going without losing context.

It's like cleaning up a messy desk before starting a new task.

Same workspace, way less clutter to scan through every time.

And finally, whenever you're about to start a complex task, just add "ultrathink" at the end of your prompt.

It forces Claude to think through the entire problem before writing a single line of code. The result?

Fewer mistakes, less wasted tokens, and code that actually works on the first try.

These three tricks alone can stretch your usage by hours every single week.

Especially if you're running long coding sessions or building production apps.

#Claudeai #claudecode #claudetips #aitipsandtricks
